Principle 5: A Typical Day
A Busy Morning
Usually I wake up before my husband and child/children.
I try to exercise every morning, but this is hard because I have other things to do.
I exercise as much as I can.
While my family is sleeping, I am busy in the kitchen preparing breakfast.
After I finish making breakfast, I wake up my husband and child/children, and I help them get ready for work and school.
Sometimes, I often go to work without eating breakfast.
In the Morning
When my husband leaves for work, and my children leaves for school, I usually do housework.
Sometimes there is too much work to do, and it can be very stressful for me.
I usually spend my time cleaning and doing the laundry.
After I finish with the housework, I go grocery shopping.
In the Afternoon
After I finish shopping for groceries, I’m sleepy and feel like having a nap, but I can’t.
I am busy in the afternoons taking my child/children to their (Subject) institute.
After I return home, I need to hurry up and prepare dinner before my family comes home.
My child/children typically return at 6:00 p.m., and my husband usually comes in between 7:00 and 8:00 p.m.
Dinnertime and At Night
I usually eat dinner with my child/children because my husband oftentimes works late.
Before my husband comes home, I usually help my child/children with their homework.
When my husband returns, we mostly spend time talking or watching television together.
My family is always happy to see me, and my busy day and stress is forgotten.
